name: fullscreen
description: Enter or exit fullscreen mode for the Jarvis interface. Use when the user says 'go fullscreen', 'fullscreen mode', 'make it fullscreen', 'exit fullscreen', 'leave fullscreen', or 'go back to normal'.

parameters.description: Use 'enter' when the user wants to go fullscreen. Use 'exit' when they want to leave fullscreen. Use 'toggle' to switch between states.
